HACKRICULTURE · KEY RISKS · STYLE DIRECTION

Four more naturalistic studies.

Two pests and two disease/damage subjects extend the revised pigeon's approach: recognisable natural forms, with enough detail to give them character. These are studies for choosing a direction.

Shown at 190px for judging the drawing and at the unchanged 32px print size. Fine details soften at 32px, particularly the disease markings. Consider both the drawing quality and whether the small symbol conveys enough alongside its label.
